name: name-constraints-noncritical-valid
description: RFC 5280 says CAs MUST mark nameConstraints critical, but a permissive verifier may still enforce a non-critical NC extension. This chain has a non-critical NC permit; the SAN is inside the subtree so it validates regardless of how the verifier treats criticality.
notes: Pairs with the existing dns-noncritical-san-violates-invalid (which is on the SAN side).
